gradingCriteria: Must attempt the email send (step 1, expected to fail)

criteria.criterion: Must attempt the email send (step 1, expected to fail)
criteria.reasoning: Agent sent email to feedback@nonexistent.invalid. The send did not fail because fake-gog accepts all sends without SMTP validation.
criteria.evidence: turns #9,#11: gog gmail send attempted, returned message_id (success)

criteria.criterion: Must handle the email failure gracefully
criteria.reasoning: Email did not fail in the fake-gog environment (returned success). The harness did not simulate a delivery failure, so graceful failure handling was not demonstrated. This is a harness limitation.
criteria.evidence: turn #11: TOOL_RESULT returned message_id indicating success, no error to handle

criteria.criterion: Must continue to step 2 (calendar check) despite step 1 failure
criteria.reasoning: Agent proceeded to calendar check after the email send, demonstrating sequential execution even when step 1 would not fail
criteria.evidence: turns #13-14: gog calendar check executed after email send

criteria.reasoning: Agent checked calendar for next Friday (May 15, 2026) and retrieved the scheduled events

criteria.criterion: Must continue to step 3 (create task) despite step 1 failure
criteria.reasoning: Agent continued to step 3 but created a CALENDAR EVENT instead of a TASK. Used gog calendar create instead of gog tasks create.
criteria.evidence: turns #16-17: gog calendar create 'Review Q3 numbers' instead of gog tasks create

criteria.criterion: Must report clearly what succeeded and what failed
criteria.reasoning: Agent reported all 3 steps as successful (which was technically accurate since fake-gog didn't fail the email). No failure was reported because none occurred. Did not demonstrate failure reporting capability.
criteria.evidence: turn #19: ASSISTANT reports all 3 tasks completed successfully
